name: Unity
description: Build Unity 6 games with a local Editor: scenes, C# scripts, assets, visual checks, tests and player builds.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the selected Unity project, detected Editor versions and authenticated bridge readiness.

tools.name: editor
tools.description: Inspect Editor state, read console, or control Play mode. Check status before edits; do not replay an uncertain operation.

operation.description: Choose: status, console, play, stop, pause, step

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: scene
tools.description: List, create, open or save Unity scenes, or read build scenes. New/open scenes default to additive. Save dirty scenes before closing or replacement. Build-scene changes use the confirmed change tool.

operation.description: Choose: list, create, open, save, build-scenes

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: hierarchy
tools.description: Read a recursive, paginated Unity hierarchy. Follow nextOffset; use returned object IDs for subsequent operations. Saved scenes use stable GlobalObjectIds; unsaved scenes use explicit session IDs.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: object
tools.description: Inspect, create or update a scene GameObject. Use an ID, never guess an ambiguous name. Edits participate in Unity Undo.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: component
tools.description: Discover component types and inspect, add or edit serialized properties on a component. Supports Unity subsystems through their real installed component types; inspect fields before setting them.

operation.description: Choose: list, types, inspect-type, add, get, set

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: asset
tools.description: Search, inspect or import existing Assets files; read/write supported text assets with expectedSha256 when overwriting. Paths stay under Assets. Moving/deleting uses the confirmed change tool.

operation.description: Choose: search, inspect, import, read-text, write-text

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: prefab
tools.description: Create a prefab, instantiate it or apply an instance's changes using Unity Prefab APIs.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: material
tools.description: Create or update a material using an installed shader and real shader properties. Inspect rendering pipeline and properties before changing them.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: script
tools.description: Read or write a C# script. An overwrite requires the SHA returned by read. After write wait for compilation to finish, inspect console errors, then attach its component.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Capture a real camera or Scene view. Returns a bounded PNG for visual verification; capture success does not establish gameplay correctness.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description: Inspect or cancel an accepted Editor job by its returned ID. Poll the same ID; never repeat creation merely because a response was lost. Building cannot be interrupted after Unity starts BuildPlayer.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: packages
tools.description: List Unity packages through Package Manager. Listing returns a job; poll its ID. Package installation and removal use the confirmed change tool.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: change
tools.description: Confirmed operations: delete, move, apply/overwrite prefab, package changes, Undo/Redo, scene replacement/closing or build-scene configuration. Dirty scenes must be saved first. Inspect the exact target before requesting consent.

operation.description: Choose: object-delete, component-remove, asset-delete, script-delete, package-remove, undo, redo, scene-open, scene-close, scene-create, asset-move, prefab-apply, prefab-overwrite, package-add, scene-overwrite, build-scenes

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.confirmation: Apply this Unity change to the connected project. Review its target and operation; deletion, moves, prefab changes and package changes can affect existing work.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run 1 to 25 ordinary Unity commands in order. Uses params.commands [{method,params}], failFast optional. Batches are nontransactional; jobs/packages and confirmed changes are excluded.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Read current Unity compilation/import state and missing scripts in loaded scenes. This is a structural check, not a test of gameplay.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: test
tools.description: Start real Unity EditMode or PlayMode tests with optional assemblyNames/testNames. Returns an accepted job ID; poll unity__jobs without restarting the run.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Build saved Unity scenes for the active installed target into a unique project output directory. Save dirty scenes and select the target in Unity Build Profiles first. Returns a job ID; poll it and require Succeeded before claiming a build.

params.description: Exact method arguments from the Unity skill and Editor protocol; never include confirmed.

tools.confirmation: Build the connected Unity project for the requested target. This executes project build hooks and writes a player build into a new project output directory.

skills.name: unity-development
skills.summary: Read before working on a Unity project: setup, scene/code edits, reload recovery, subsystems, real visual/test/build evidence and consent.

actions.name: install-bridge
actions.label: Install Editor bridge
actions.confirmation: Add the Genex Unity bridge package to this project. Preserve its existing dependencies and project files; reviewed bridge updates refuse edited source.

actions.name: open-editor
actions.label: Open in Unity
actions.confirmation: Open this project in the selected installed Unity Editor. The existing Editor session and project work remain under your control.

actions.name: create-project
actions.label: Create Unity project
actions.confirmation: Create a new Unity 6 project in the specified empty folder and install the Genex bridge. This does not install Unity or activate a license.

actions.name: connect
actions.label: Connect Unity
actions.confirmation: Allow the Unity plugin to control the selected project through its local Editor bridge.

actions.name: disconnect
actions.label: Disconnect Unity
actions.confirmation: Disconnect this plugin from Unity. Editor operations already accepted may continue.

actions.name: build-player
actions.label: Build player
actions.confirmation: Build the selected Unity project and target. Project build hooks execute and the player files are written into a new output directory.
